# REI Bridal

> REI Bridal is a luxury bridal boutique located in Kerry, Ireland. We offer a curated collection of designer wedding gowns by appointment only, with an emphasis on private, unhurried appointments, expert styling guidance, and in-house alterations. Our boutique serves brides across Kerry, Munster, and Ireland.

## About

REI Bridal was founded on the belief that finding your wedding dress should feel like one of the greatest joys of your engagement. We carry a deliberately small, carefully chosen selection of international bridal designers — each chosen for exceptional craft, distinctive design, and the ability to make a bride feel completely herself. Every appointment is private: the boutique belongs entirely to you and your guests for two hours.

- Location: Kerry, Ireland
- Contact: hello@reibridal.ie
- Website: https://www.reibridal.ie
- Instagram: @reibridal
- Opening Hours: Tuesday–Friday 10:00–18:00, Saturday 09:00–17:00, Sunday & Monday by appointment

## Services

- Private bridal appointments (2 hours, by booking only)
- In-house alterations and fittings
- Personalised styling guidance
- Bespoke and special order gowns
- Complimentary champagne at appointments

## Designers We Carry

- **Sarah Seven** (USA) — Romantically bohemian gowns in silk charmeuse and French lace, made in San Francisco
- **Flora & Lane** (Australia) — Clean architectural silhouettes with extraordinary fabric, from Melbourne
- **Anne Barge** (USA) — Timeless elegance with architectural cuts, designing since 1969
- **Rime Arodaky** (France) — Parisian cool meets bridal confidence
- **Halfpenny London** (UK) — British romance with delicate detailing and silk separates

## Pricing

- Wedding gowns: approximately €1,500 – €5,500 (price on application)
- Bridesmaid gowns: from €280
- Alterations: quoted individually at first fitting
- Appointments: complimentary

## Frequently Asked Questions

**When should I start looking for my wedding dress?**
12–18 months before your wedding date. Most designer gowns take 4–6 months to produce, and alterations require an additional 2–3 months.

**How long is a bridal appointment?**
2 hours. All appointments are private and exclusive — no other brides, no distractions.

**How many guests can I bring?**
We recommend 2–3 of your most trusted companions. Smaller groups tend to result in clearer, more confident decisions.

**Do you offer in-house alterations?**
Yes. Our trusted in-house alterations team handles everything from bustle and hem to structural adjustments.

**Can I try on gowns without booking?**
No — all appointments must be booked in advance so we can prepare the boutique and a personalised selection for you.
